title: About PhySoc & Working Committee
description: Learn about the Physics Society of IIT Kharagpur, our vision, events, and the 20-member student Working Committee including Secretaries, Senior Student Members, and Student Members.

title: Academic Wing
description: Academic Wing of PhySoc IIT Kharagpur. Facilitating peer mentorship, subject roadmaps, course handbooks, and research domain discussions across Condensed Matter, Theoretical Physics, Biophysics, Photonics, Quantum Mechanics, and Astrophysics.

title: Events & Activities
description: Explore upcoming and past events hosted by PhySoc IIT Kharagpur, including Physics Carnivals, Guest Lectures, Telescope Observation Nights, Competitions, and Socials.

title: Student Resources & Handbooks
description: Course handbooks, curriculum guides, research project archives, summer internship opportunities, and study materials for physics undergraduates at IIT Kharagpur.

title: Competitions Committee
description: Organizing physics quizzes, problem-solving hackathons, olympiads, and inter-hall physics competitions at IIT Kharagpur.

title: Seminars & Guest Lectures Committee
description: Hosting research talks, faculty seminars, alumni sessions, and interactive workshops with leading physicists.

title: Outreach Committee
description: Promoting public interest in physics on campus, school visits, science demonstrations, and astronomy outreach.

title: Projects Committee
description: Guiding undergraduate research projects, lab experiments, simulation tools, and technical physics builds.

title: Media & Tech Committee
description: Managing the website, digital posters, social media channels, event photography, and tech infrastructure for PhySoc.

title: Socials & Community Committee
description: Bringing the IIT Kharagpur physics community together through department socials, freshers welcome, farewells, and informal meetups.
